job.job_description:
Job Title: AI Engineer

As an AI Engineer, you will work directly with the CEO to develop and implement AI-driven solutions that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) like GPT-4, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and API integration. You will have the freedom to experiment and design AI systems that align with our product s future vision.

Roles & Responsibility
-Design, develop, and deploy AI models using LLM technologies (like GPT-4) for various
business applications.
- Integrate AI models with our existing systems via API integrations.
- Develop NLP models and solutions for improving language understanding and generating insights.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement AI solutions.
- Stay updated on the latest AI trends and best practices to continuously enhance our AI capabilities.

Core Skills-
-Proven experience with LLMs, GPT-4 or similar models.
- Strong expertise in NLP and AI frameworks.
- Hands-on experience with API integration.
- Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or JavaScript.
- Knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure) for deploying AI models.
- Solid understanding of AI/ML workflows, tools, and frameworks (e.g. Google ADK, Langgraph)
-Solid understanding of LLM tracing and observability tools (eg langsmith,langfuse)
- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.




Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
